answers.core: I guess an addon that is capable of updating an addon would also be able to update itself. But I feel like it would eventually just become a pseudo-fork competing with the asset library and splitting resources.
answers.workaround: Can be solved in a few lines of bash script probably, but I think it is important enough to be its own feature.

title: Allow overriding existing files/folders when installing assets from the asset library (to update existing assets)
